object.description: Specific object requested by the user.

parts.description: List of structural parts that make up the requested object. Each item represents a unique part instance.

id.description: Unique identifier for this specific part instance. Distinguishes it from other parts with the same name (e.g. 'leg_1_L' vs 'leg_1_R').

length_weight.description: Relative importance of the part, used as an initial estimate for stick length during tree generation.

segment_index.description: Position of this part within a chained body sequence (1, 2, 3, ...), used only for objects whose body is split into multiple sticks to provide enough joints for many limb-pairs (e.g. an ant's body_1/body_2). Null for every part that is not a body segment.

symmetry.description: Optional metadata describing whether this part belongs to a mirrored or repeated group.

group.description: Identifier shared by mirrored or repeated parts (e.g. 'leg', 'wing', 'antler', 'claw').

side.description: Relative position of the part with respect to the object's symmetry axis.

order_index.description: Position of this repeated pair/group along the object's main axis (1, 2, 3, ...), used to line up against a body chain's segment_index when there are more than two repeated groups (e.g. leg_1, leg_2, leg_3 on an ant).
